instruction: Fix `apply` so the division operator returns a float result instead of truncating with integer floor division.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc.py b/rpncalc.py
--- a/rpncalc.py
+++ b/rpncalc.py
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@
     if op == "*":
         return a * b
     if op == "/":
-        return a // b
+        return a / b
     raise ValueError(f"unknown operator: {op}")
